identity_rules: Feedback is append-only evidence and never overwrites Source/Artifact/Advice.
Acknowledgement, modified acceptance, rejection, ignore, defer, question answer, execution and result are distinct records.
Only explicit user confirmation may create a scoped, revocable future-date memory/preference; silence and one-off events cannot.

states.affects_current_understanding: records selected modified disposition, not execution
close this advice; optional reason is evidence

states.affects_future_date: blocked until explicit confirmation, scope and freshness are supplied

withdrawal_rule: Revoking ANS/FDB/EXE/RES stales or recomputes dependent DER/ADV. It preserves historical identities and cannot rewrite the original advice, work source or health source.
close_reopen_rule: Reopen reconstructs Source/Artifact, Q/ANS, original ADV, feedback/disposition, EXE, RES, each DER and MEM-CAND separately. It must not turn a completed action into acceptance, a result into a medical fact, or a candidate memory into an approved preference.
classification: candidate lifecycle contract; no real feedback or preference was collected
